claim: Fresh derived-timing seed 990023 qualified the intro and Route 2 repairs, then stopped at an incidental battle on Viridian Forest training-route step 65. The failure preceded scheduled battles and every learned battle or training decision. It preserves another authored traversal assumption rather than attributing it to a model.

failure.message: Unexpected battle interrupted forest training route at step 65.

diagnosis.finding: The first ninety Forest directions were open-loop until a separately seeded Kakuna lesson. Timing variance can produce an ordinary encounter earlier, and the chapter rejected it instead of distinguishing incidental travel from its three intentional training battles.
diagnosis.model_boundary: No scheduled battle, learned move, battle-control, switch-target, training-control, or trainee/venue decision had occurred. The objective model had only selected the singleton first composite.

repair.behavior: Every Forest travel segment now uses the map-bound authenticated traversal, while the three Kakuna triggers and mandatory Bug Catcher remain separate fight contracts. Incidental Forest wilds may be fled under one chapter-wide budget; intentional training encounters are never routed through the flee helper. Upper Route 2 now uses the same cumulative Route 2 receipt as the lower crossing.
repair.rom_free_gate: Public-artifact and documentation checks, regenerated-registry check, Ruff, mypy across 128 source modules, and 2,182 tests passed; three integration tests were deselected and one expected failure remained expected.
repair.next_gate: Commit and push the qualified repair, then run a fresh uncounted derived-timing root. Counted v95 remains unopened.
